items.title: See every scheduled export and who owns it
items.summary: Admins with the Manage property settings permission can see, edit and delete every scheduled export in the property, with a new Owner column, owner filter and bulk delete.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users; only admins with Manage property settings see everyone's schedules.

items.title: France e-Reporting in Mews POS
items.summary: B2C sales in Mews POS are automatically reported to the French tax administration via an approved platform. Set up in POS Back Office; PMS properties first need the Compliance Suite add-on.
items.segmentation: All Mews POS properties in France (incl. overseas departments).

items.title: Sync spaces, space types and floors from Mews to Flexkeeping
items.summary: The Flexkeeping integration gets a settings tab and automatic sync of spaces, space types and floors from Mews.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Behind a feature flag: off for existing properties, on by default for new ones.

items.title: Redesigned bookable service setup and settings pages
items.summary: Clearer layout and guidance on the create-bookable-service and service settings pages (Settings > Services). Data and capabilities are unchanged.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Rolled out via feature flag from 12 Oct.

items.title: Cancellation fees now post to accounting on the consumption date
items.summary: Cancellation-fee items post on their consumption date, which can change timing in accounting reports and exports.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Enabled for all properties at GA.

items.title: Tips report in Mews POS (North America tipping)
items.summary: New report of tips, service charges and tip-pool contributions by date, outlet and employee, with CSV/Excel/PDF export. Employees see their own tips in the POS Android app.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Properties with tipping enabled on at least one outlet.

items.title: POS multi-tax and net pricing for North America
items.summary: Multi-tax and net pricing let Mews POS be used in North America.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. North America.

items.title: Accurate no-show figures in the Reservation report
items.summary: Expired Inquired/Optional reservations now cancel as 'Confirmation missed'; only confirmed guests who never arrive are 'No show'.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users; nothing to set up.

items.title: Sell limits: cap rooms sold per rate
items.summary: Cap rooms sold per rate or rate group per day, optionally by room category. Set up in Settings.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Applies in Mews Operations, Booking Engine and Mews API only, not yet other channel managers/CRSs/booking engines.

items.title: Clear price and occupancy overrides in bulk (Revenue workspace)
items.summary: Clear price and/or occupancy overrides across a date range in one action, filtered by day of week, override type and space category.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Revenue workspace users.

items.title: Set a different price per date in one bulk edit (RMS)
items.summary: Bulk price editing can set a unique custom price or RMS price hierarchy per date in one edit.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Mews RMS users.

items.title: Reservation table view and side panel
items.summary: New filterable table of reservations and a side panel to view/edit reservations from Timeline and Reservation Overview, easier for large group blocks.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Issue a duplicate key to keep existing keys working
items.summary: When issuing a key, choose 'new' (cancels earlier keys) or 'duplicate' (keeps them active). Works for physical and digital keys.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. All Mews Operations users.

items.title: Billing visibility at check-out
items.summary: The check-out dialog shows unbalanced bills (clickable), bills that close and where closed bills are sent, with editable email saved to the guest profile.
items.segmentation: Tier 3. Slack states Germany only; the Jira ticket also mentions a phased rollout by market, so check availability per property before promising.

items.title: Multicurrency: clearer Payment report and invoices
items.summary: Payment report and invoices show Multicurrency revenue more clearly.
items.segmentation: Tier 4. Only customers with Multicurrency enabled.

items.title: Granular user permissions for accounting
items.summary: Remaining view/edit permissions for accounting categories, outlets, Bills & invoices and Manager reports and ledgers.
items.segmentation: Admins; in-app message planned.

items.title: Multicurrency on Mews Terminals (US, Canada, Adyen Europe)
items.summary: Guests will be able to pay in their home currency on Mews Terminals, with rate and fee shown up front; the property keeps part of the conversion fee. Gradual rollout, email on activation.
items.pitch: Position as 'coming soon', not live yet.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Selected US/Canada properties plus Adyen-powered terminals in Europe. Not live yet; nothing for customers to do.

items.title: Report period dates change in Manager and Ledger Activity exports
items.summary: Period display and export file names will show a true from-to period matching the business day. This can break automated imports of these files.
items.pitch: Heads-up for customers with automated imports.
items.segmentation: Gradual rollout to selected properties; no public date yet. Warn customers with scheduled exports.

items.title: Bed-based hostel reporting in Mews BI
items.summary: Mews BI will report on beds, not rooms, so dorm occupancy is accurate for hostels.
items.segmentation: Tier 1. No date set.

items.title: Online payments availability on Adyen
items.summary: Coming-soon content created for online payments availability on Adyen. Details limited.
items.segmentation: Tier 2. Timing TBC; check the ticket before sharing.

items.title: Compliance Suite Tax Automation and Tax Intelligence go live 1 Dec
items.summary: In-app messages tell users in many European markets and the US that Tax Automation and Tax Intelligence go live on 1 Dec 2026 (Czechia also EET 2.0).
items.segmentation: Messages launched 13 Oct, relaunch 1 Nov.

items.title: Fin replaces Ada as customer-facing support bot
items.summary: Fin AI support agent went live 26 Oct for Support and Onboarding on PMS, POS and Flexkeeping, in five languages. Hypercare runs to 6 Nov; Ada stays for EMS and Atomize.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Events rebuild in the PMS (Alpha late Nov, Beta H1 2027)
items.summary: R&D working assumptions only: Alpha late Nov 2026 with design partners, Beta H1 2027, soft GA late Q1 2027. GTM says don't hard-commit dates and not to demo externally; the teaser video is for 1:1 use only. Hold announcements.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Fintech look-ahead: Payments Checkout GA, Payouts API beta, iDEAL recurring
items.summary: October TOI lists Mews Payments Checkout (GA), Payouts and Balance Transactions APIs (beta), recurring iDEAL payments and a new Payments report as upcoming. Internal TOI, not public.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.
